name: Corvus Clueless
source:
A detective story about the rivalry between a raven and a cat, tourists from the underworld and the case of a missing person that could ruin Halloween!

[From [url=https://tinyfacegames.itch.io/corvus-clueless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一则侦探故事：一只乌鸦和一只猫彼此较劲，来自冥界的游客纷纷现身，而一桩失踪案可能会毁掉万圣节！

[来源：[url=https://tinyfacegames.itch.io/corvus-clueless]Itch.io[/url]]
